newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ Port Auth. plans $1.2 bln bond sale by Dec.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ Port Auth. plans $1.2 bln bond sale by Dec.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, which last month authorized issuing as much as $1.2 billion of special project bonds, on Monday said that it expected to sell them by the beginning of December.

"The plan is to have the prospectus for the special project bonds at around the end of this month or early December," said Bill Cahill, a Port Authority spokesman, who added that the bonds would be sold around the same time.
The funds raised by selling the bonds will be used to build a new international arrivals building at John F Kennedy International Airport in New York City.
The bi-state agency has selected Lehman Brothers and Citicorp to lead the bond syndicate.
